task.title: P6-126: Fix /my's Where column showing stale collection names after rename or delete
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 4 — Correctness, /my collection page, tree and collection header). Original id: P6-126. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**`/my`'s "Where" column shows stale collection names after a sidebar rename or delete** (was `P6-017b`). The `all_cards` resource's source tuple is `(url_q, url_cursor, holdings_revision)` (`all_cards.rs:163-167`) and the file never references `TreeManage::revision` at all.
